name: How long does a typical roof installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical roof installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a roof installation varies significantly based on factors such as the size and complexity of your roof, the chosen material, and weather conditions. A standard residential shingle roof installation might take 3-5 days, while a larger or more complex tile roof could extend to 1-2 weeks. We aim to complete projects efficiently without compromising on quality. Before starting, we provide a detailed timeline specific to your project, keeping you informed throughout the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Roof installation time varies, typically 3-5 days for shingles and 1-2 weeks for larger tile roofs, depending on roof size, complexity, and material.
